metadata.question: Were there more snow in north-central Chile in July, 16 2022 than July 7, 2022?

data.exec_msg:
Date: 2022-07-07, Avg Snow Cover (%): 30.52, Valid Pixels: 19198
Date: 2022-07-16, Avg Snow Cover (%): 43.32, Valid Pixels: 18338
Evidence: Snow cover on 2022-07-16 (43.32%) was higher than on 2022-07-07 (30.52%).
